title: Newhalo news list
description: A press list on paper: a 64px heading with an outlined button, then black-hairline rows of thumbnail (1.81:1, 8px corners), headline, summary and a small arrow tile. Rows rise in 50px as they scroll into view while thumbnails settle from 1.15×; the hovered row lightens edge to edge and its arrow turns orange. The last row fades out under a 'more' button. On phones each row stacks.
notes: needs JavaScript only for the 'more' button (hydrate: visible)
name: newhalo-news

props.name: cta
props.description: the outlined button beside the heading

props.description: all stories; the first `initial` show in full, the next one fades out under "more"

props.description: the label of the button that shows more rows
